cases.question: What caused the differences in substance use screening records between encounter types?
cases.message: These synthetic records can describe differences but cannot show what caused them. If you want a descriptive comparison, ask for record counts or percentages instead. No analysis was run.

cases.question: Which disease had the most patients in 2019?
cases.message: The conditions table includes findings and social factors, so it is not a disease-only list. Do you mean distinct patients with a new condition record starting in the year, or with a record active during the year? Please choose a record definition before analysis.
